channel.title: Daily Star Sunday - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Star Sunday (dailystar.co.uk)

item.title: Jay-Z explains why he refused to settle sexual-assault lawsuit in rare interview
item.description: Jay-Z has opened up about being accused of sexual assault in a civil lawsuit in 2024 and explained why he refused to settle despite saying it would've been easier and cheaper

item.title: Superman bombshell dead after 15 years fighting
item.description: A Hollywood starlet, who was well-known for her role in the Superman franchise among other blockbusters, has passed after fighting with her health for well over a decade

item.title: NHS warns of early hay fever season as allergy sufferers shouldn't overmedicate
item.description: As spring sweeps across the UK, millions are bracing for what experts warn could be the worst hay fever season yet with pollen levels already spiking

item.title: 'World's sickest raffle' offers chance to shoot 32 wild animals for just £13
item.description: Outrage has erupted over a £13 South African raffle offering winners "unlimited bullets" to shoot 32 wild animals, sparking urgent calls for a UK trophy import ban

item.title: NATO scrambles warplanes for second time today as Putin deploys Iranian drones
item.description: Iranian-designed Shahed drone hit the historic centre of Lviv and was seen slamming into a UNESCO listed site, leading to NATO warplanes being scrambled in neighbouring Poland

item.title: Dozens killed including 13 children in hospital bombing on religious holiday
item.description: WHO chief Tedros Ahdhanom Ghebreyesus revealed that a horrific drone strike on a Teaching Hospital killed 64 people including 13 children, and left 89 people injured

item.title: Scott Mills could be in line for huge £160k annual pension despite BBC axe
item.description: The BBC has confirmed that all contracts with former Radio 2 DJ Scott have been terminated, but the presenter could be bringing in a hefty pension later in his life

item.title: Influencer tells of wacky requests from fans - including naked fruit cutting
item.description: Sweetie Fox says her followers regularly ask her to transform into everything from fantasy characters to cartoon icons - but some ideas are so strange she can't help but laugh.

item.title: Cat owners share 10 tactics they use to win their pets over - 'they do not care'
item.description: Most cat owners think their pet ignores them — so they resort to treats, baby talk and slow blinks to win them over.

item.title: Bee expert shares 5 'small changes' to make your garden into a buzzing sanctuary
item.description: National Geographic explorer Dr Rosa Vásquez Espinoza shared her expert tips for creating a bee-friendly garden, including embracing weeds like dandelions and letting spaces grow wild

item.title: Mysterious Iranian 'Forbidden Island' that holds the key to Trump ending war
item.description: The island of Kharg, has reportedly been "obliterated" by American strikes, although much is known about whether the island's many points of interest have survived

item.title: Furious Russians turn on 'delusional' Putin as internet blackout sparks backlash
item.description: Angry Russians and former Kremlin loyalists are revolting against Vladimir Putin as "delusional" internet blackouts spark rare protests and a national outcry

item.title: Britons are becoming happier people despite global wars and cost of living hell
item.description: “Smiley face” button data from airports, shopping centres and public toilets said negative responses in the UK had fallen over the past decade

item.title: Helen Flanagan fumes as Travelodge staff ‘threaten to call police’ in hotel row
item.description: Helen Flanagan has hit out at Travelodge after claiming a staff member threatened to call the police when she slept through checkout time during her UK theatre tour

item.title: Man Utd star charged with improper conduct and risks facing extended ban
item.description: A Manchester United star has been charged with improper conduct and risks facing an extended ban for his reaction to referee Stuart Attwell during the controversial 2-2 draw against Bournemouth
